title: A flaw in Node.js TLS hostname verification allows a certificate without a matching IP address SAN to authenticate a…
description: A vulnerability in Node.js TLS hostname verification allows a certificate lacking a matching IP address Subject Alternative Name (SAN) to authenticate improperly. This flaw affects Node.js version 3.0. No CVSS score or detailed impact metrics are provided. No patch or remediation information is currently available. There is no evidence of exploitation in the wild at this time.
